name: 360° Rotating Bookshelf – 4 Tier Multi-Level Book Display and Storage Shelf, White Finish
description:
The Rocco Rotating Bookshelf is a versatile shoe rack that rotates 360º, offering convenient access to all your books without bending down or rearranging items. Its unique spinning design allows users to showcase their books in a full 360° view, making it simple to find and retrieve titles. The tower shape enables storage of numerous books in a compact footprint; the 4-tier rack holds about 100 medium-sized books, the 3-tier aprox. 75 medium-sized books, while the 2-tier version accommodates roughly 50 books. Made from sturdy engineered wood with a scratch-resistant finish, the bookshelf features plastic buffers to safeguard your floors. Designed for straightforward assembly, the tall bookcase comes with detailed installation instructions and video tutorials in its manual.
• 360° ROTATING BOOKSHELF: Rocco Revolving Bookshelf enhances convenience by allowing easy access to all the books without the need to bend down or shuffle items around. With its spinning design, you can display your books in a 360° view and easily access them without any hassle.
• MORE BOOKS IN LESS SPACE: With its tower-shaped design, this rotating book shelf can hold a large number of books in a small area. The 4-tier rack can accommodate approx. 100 medium-sized books, 3-tier approx. 50 books. and the 2-tier bookshelf can accommodate approx. 50 books.
• STURDY CONSTRUCTION: The book shelf tower is made of durable engineered wood with a scratch-resistant surface and includes plastic buffers to prevent floor scratches.
• EASY TO ASSEMBLE: This tall bookcase is designed for easy assembly. We provide comprehensive installation instructions and video links in its Assembling manual. Alternatively, if you require a paid assembly service, you can contact Rocco’s service support, and we will always be happy to help you.
• WARRANTY: It comes with a 1-year warranty for any manufacturing defect.

name: Wine Fiber Glass Rock Carvern Indoor Water Fountain
description: "The vibrant and unconventional design of this water fountain from Expleasia Décor redefines the very idea of luxury. Replicating cascade cavern, this water fountain bring rare sight of nature to your home. As water glides down stacked caverns, it produces blabbering sound and uplifts the mood. Water is a symbol of wealth and prosperity. The flowing water of the water feature helps to reactivate life-force of the space, restores balance and produce beneficial energy. Dazzling built-in lights illuminate water and look wonderful in the evening. Whether you’re looking for something modern, classical or even custom, this will suffice all your purpose. Best part of this water fountain is its compact size. It can be placed at the home entrance, in your living room, hall way or your work place. If you have a lawn or garden then install it near plants and enjoy the bliss and serenity of nature. Crafted from sturdy polyresin ,it offers realistic feature of a mountain rock and incredible durability. An included electric pump makes this fountain low-maintenance and inexpensive to own, as it does not require any extra water lines or plumbing. All you need to do is plug it into a standard wall outlet, turn it on and watch as the water falls down to the bottom, where it recirculates over and over until you turn it off. "

name: Wine Wood Stone Indoor Water Fountain
description: "Resting wood Stone Falls is a stunning design with water cascading like a see-through curtain over the resting wooden logs and stones. Designed to replicate real tree trunks and stones as if picked from a hiking trail or along a river. Bumpy texture and irregularities in size are just as you would expect to find in a natural setting. For nature lovers, this view is sheer joy and a blissful experience. Whether you’re looking for an indoor fountain for your home or corporate office, this water fountain from Expleasia Décor is here to bring calmness and harmony of nature at your doorstep. The babbling sound of water as it flows down revitalizes your mind. Place it near your favourite place in living room or even at the entrance of your home. Front entrance is a great place for this water fountain if you want to encourage wealth and cash flow because it is where energy and opportunities enter our homes and our lives. Made from high quality polyresin and fibers. The benefits of using polyresin and fibers are many, including excellent durability and the ability to replicate the look of many natural materials, such as wood, stones or rocks. This fully-assembled fountain comes with everything you need and can be set up in just minutes. When you receive it, simply fill it with water, plug it into any standard electrical outlet and turn it on. Water is gently guided downward from tier to tier with the help of an included electric pump before continuously recirculating from the bottom pool for an instant soothing effect. The padded protective feet keep the fountain from damaging the surface you place it on, and the camouflage door allows for easy pump access. This peaceful fountain even comes with lights in different tiers which cast a glow on the cascading water. Place it in your balcony or garden in vicinity of plants, sit back and relax in the evening. With perfect size and look to match any décor, this water fountain is a must buy."

This sofa's frame is made from seasoned solid wood with plywood boxing that undergoes a 3-step treatment for protection against borers and is kiln-dried for moisture control.

4 layers of high-grade foam

The cushions are made of 4 layers of foam of varying densities, providing the perfect 'sit' experience.

Long-lasting suspension system

This sofa is supported on a foundation of 3 inch wide elastic bands, thicker and more durable than the industry standard.

Anti-sag construction

This sofa is designed to combat sagging. The multi-density foam in the seat cushions reduces sagging due to prolonged use. A grid of polyfill pockets in the back cushions prevents the cushions from weighing down because of gravity.

name: Resting Rock Stone Fountain For Indoor And Outdoor
description: From our exclusive range of water fountains this one is our personal favourite. Sleek and elegant in design, this water feature from Expleasia Décor will complement the aesthetic of your personal space. It will blend equally in both modern as well as contemporary interior. Made from durable polyresin, the detailed design and subtle color of rock is both realistic in appearance and long lasting. The benefits of using polyresin includes excellent durability and the ability to replicate the look of many natural materials, such rock, stone or wood. Looks like an exemplary work of rock carving, this water fountain shows three small pots mounted on three green brick pillars from where sparkling water cascades down to large pot at the bottom. Flowing water brings along so much peace, serenity and calmness and becomes a delightful thing to watch. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor usage. Whether you place it at the home entrance, in your living room, hall way or your work place, this water fountain will become focal point in your décor. The gentle sound of water arising from the water feature is a great de-stressor. It promotes relaxation, thoughtfulness, peace, comfort and sleep. More sleep and less stress make one naturally more energetic, happy and optimistic, leading to a heightened quality of life and better health. This fully-assembled fountain comes with everything you need and can be set up in just minutes. When you receive it, simply fill it with water, plug it into any standard electrical outlet and turn it on. Water recirculates through an included electric pump for instant soothing effect. If you are a nature lover and like keeping indoor plants then this water fountain placed in vicinity will also help in further improving the air quality and act as a natural humidifier thereby making your plants vibrant and healthy.

name: Topolino Engineered Wood Kids Chair in Yellow Colour
description:
The Perfect Kids Study Chair for Everyday Learning: Give your child the comfort and support they need during study time, homework, reading, and creative activities. This Kids Study Chair is thoughtfully designed for children ages 2 to 8 years, offering the ideal seating height, ergonomic back support, and long-lasting durability.
